stateDefinitions.unverified: Protocol and named local validation exist; actual account/server acceptance has not been exercised.

features: Hot words, per-account recent search, exact sorting, coupon filter, product detail and explicit shop URL
Global/my/user lists; loaded-page categories and vote-enabled ranking; create/edit covers, categories, top limit, voting
Embedded list items; search/link conversion add, recommendation/cancel, reason/photo edit and confirmed item removal
Owned published-feed selection and binding; full comment actions delegated to existing feed Detail
All/wish/buy goods feeds, store and product albums; personal product-list entry reuses native Goods routes

Product-album actual feed detail, ordinary/ladder creation and owner editing; complete custom/product-linked project order/add/remove, reason and image fields, preserved project IDs and five ladder levels
Confirmed owner album deletion; permission/exhaustion/review/history boundaries and missing detail states
Official cover upload for goods-list flows; immutable captcha payloads, locked pending album dialogs, guest login and account-switch invalidation of old drafts/verification callbacks

Unconfirmed goods-list/product-album creation preserves title/body/project drafts, blocks form replay and automatic retry, and offers cancellation or authenticated personal-list verification; genuine captcha retries its frozen create form.
knownLimits: Ranking/category filters operate on loaded list pages; no unknown server ranking/filter fields are invented.
Product-album detail reads feed/detail productAlbumDetailInfo, never global goodsList/list or an owner-page approximation.
Official ordinary album_type=1 and ladder=2 are supported; other types remain explicit unknowns.
Album project images can preserve unchanged public server URLs; replacement images must use official Coolapk CDN URLs. New project image sets are limited to nine.
Create targetType/targetId are protocol fields; no unconfirmed native role-specific picker is claimed. Edit relation is derived from the current official feed.
Unknown malformed media, item ids/types or node association metadata stop editing rather than silently detaching existing content.

boundaries: All mutations assert login before network. Own list and source feed are re-read and owner UID verified.
Caller cannot supply nested list ID or member feed ID; derive IDs from latest matching feed metadata.
Entry membership requires matching itemId and product_goods_id. Voting requires the list is_open_vote flag.
Replacements use official Coolapk image CDN only; unchanged existing marketplace images may be preserved from current server metadata.
Fixed official API routes only; public marketplace links are sent only to confirmed goods/addGoods service, not fetched with account headers.

Invalid data envelopes are failures, not successful empty lists. Lost transport, non-JSON/malformed responses or missing valid created IDs after goods-list/product-album creation produce WRITE_UNCONFIRMED; the renderer retains the draft, disables retry/submission and allows cancellation or checking the personal list.
Action retry uses a JSON snapshot; image captcha keeps submit disabled; account namespace changes unmount old drafts/callbacks.
Published album edit/delete read fresh owner metadata and reject historical versions; editing requires enableModify=1 and complete supported-type productAlbumDetailInfo.
Existing project IDs must belong to the fresh album, may occur once, and cannot change linked product IDs or canonical names. New rows omit id.
Native edit includes original member IDs; added/removed remote membership produces CONFLICT before writing. This is not a claim of server-side transactional revision locking.
Identity object/UID, cookie and device snapshots are checked after every album ownership read and write; cross-account responses and mutations cannot report success.
Album deletion accepts only id, confirms in the renderer and sends notNotify=0. Protected administrator parameters and unsupported history deletion are not guessed.

validation.checks: 21 unit cases and 23 isolated renderer groups passed, covering complete form identity, permission gates, encoded associations, project limits, account changes, stale membership, frozen captcha, editing, confirmed deletion, and unconfirmed creation response handling without automatic replay.

officialApk.scope: Static official APK binding/caller recovery; ignored derived DEX and Java contain no account data.
